inv.desc_en:
Retail sells magnificent commercial premises to renovate in the heart of the Centro district. Commercial area of Madrid with high pedestrian and vehicular traffic.

Characteristics:

- Surface area: 70.40 m² on the ground floor.

- Linear facade of 4.5 meters.

- Height: 3 meters.

- Smoke outlet: NO.

- Open-plan premises.

Call us to arrange an investment meeting at our offices and we will provide you with more information.

Key Planning: GOIKO, BURGER KING, STARBUCKS EDP GRAN VÍA THEATER, EL PERRO Y LA GALLETA, OTAKU CENTER, DÍA SUPERMARKETS, ZARA, CARREFOUR EXPRESS, NATURA ANIMAL, DISKPOL, LA MUCCA DE PEZ, WONDERLAND COMICS, ZARA HOME, ETC.

Retail, a leading specialist in commercial premises, business expansion, and investment, with over 2,300 successful operations in our 22 years of experience in the real estate market.

We have more premises on the most commercial streets throughout Madrid.
